title: Fast-moving wildfire threatens Reno, Nevada, forcing thousands to evacuate
desc: A fast-moving wildfire that jumped over fire trucks and made it difficult for crews to reach hot spots destroyed homes in northwest Reno, Nevada, on Sunday. Shifting winds challenged firefighters trying to bring it under control, and authorities urged some 90,000 people to evacuate.

title: Felix Health launches sleep apnea care through new collaboration with MedSleep
desc: With more than one in four Canadian adults estimated to be at high risk for obstructive sleep apnea, Felix is expanding into sleep apnea care to help patients more easily access assessment and appropriate treatment.The new offering launches across Ontario, British Columbia and Alberta through a collaboration with MedSleep, with plans to expand into other provinces throughout the fall.Felix healthcare providers can help patients access sleep-clinic assessment - including through MedSleep - while also assessing whether medical weight-management treatment may be appropriate as part of their care. TORONTO, Aug. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- As new treatment options bring growing attention to the connection between sleep apnea, obesity and metabolic health, Felix today announced the launch of sleep apnea care, including a new collaboration with MedSleep to help patients access assessment and care across Ontario, British Columbia and Alberta. Felix plans to expand the offering into other provinces in the fall.

title: Bolu Babalola's Wedding Looks Was a Dream
desc: For romance author Bolu Babalola, her wedding dress was more than just a beautiful gown. It was the result of a special bonding experience with her mother during a trip to Istanbul, where the pair designed the dress together, turning the process of creating her dream bridal look into a cherished memory. The vision was eventually brought to life by Bespoke House Fatih, resulting in a romantic mermaid gown crafted from intricate, dainty lace and delicately scattered with tiny shimmering crystals. An off-the-shoulder sweetheart neckline added a soft, feminine touch, while the long sleeves and elaborate train brought drama to the otherwise closely fitted silhouette. Speaking to Vogue, Babalola explained that the balance of the fitted gown, delicate sleeves and dramatic train allowed her to feel both regal and completely herself. The result was a wedding dress that felt elegant without losing the personality at its heart. Even her bouquet carried a personal meaning. She wanted it to be “bold and bright, like our love”, bringing a burst of colour to the romantic bridal look. From designing the gown with her mother to seeing the final vision come to life, every detail of Babalola’s wedding look was rooted in love, …
